name: find-in-images
description: A Chrome extension that makes **scanned PDFs and image-based documents searchable using native Ctrl+F** by applying OCR and injecting a hidden text layer into the DOM.

scripts.package: zip -r find-in-images-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip manifest.json icons/ viewer/ lib/ service-worker.js --exclude '*.DS_Store'

author: Suhani Pandey
